title: Associate Director of Alumni Community Engagement
description:
Position Overview

The Associate Director of Butler Community Engagement is
responsible for the development and execution of community
engagement and relationship-building plans on behalf of Butler
University. This includes but is not limited to alumni, family,
friends, and donors. This role exists to:


Support the strategic development and execution of programming
and relationship building to engage constituents with the greatest
propensity to give of their time, talent, and treasure.
Support philanthropic efforts by overseeing the strategy and
segmentation for mass solicitations.
Lead the planning and execution of the Alumni Ambassadors
Program and Alumni Appreciation Day.



*To be considered for this position candidates must submit a
cover letter with their application. *

Responsibilities

Contribute to the Butler Community Engagement Team surpassing
$1 million annual goal across, but not limited to the following:

Day of Giving
License Plate Program
Mass Solicitations
Elements Credit Card


Oversee the execution of programming that aligns with the
Strategic Alumni Engagement Imperative and engages alumni in
activities that support the University's Mission and Goals,
including Alumni Ambassadors and Alumni Appreciation Day
Create the annual segmentation strategy and content for direct
mail pieces highlighting the Butler Fund.
Facilitate communication, training, and event management as
required for assigned programs, including but not limited to
developing training and support resources and working with
appropriate partners to organize event invite lists, emails, RSVP
forms, social media, venues, catering, and additional
logistics.

Assist in the planning and execution of key University
engagement activities, including but not limited to
Homecoming.

Regularly assess program progress and report key findings to
Advancement division staff and members of the Butler University
Alumni Association Board of Directors. Research and implement
industry best practices to achieve success.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree
2-4 years of experience required including successful
experience managing, assisting, and motivating volunteers
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to
speak in front of groups
Professional, courteous, and friendly disposition; must feel
comfortable representing the University to a wide variety of
audiences
Ability to connect and build relationships with wide variety of
people
Strong project management skills and a demonstrated ability to
multi-task and set priorities within tight timeframes and within
budget
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with or
ability to learn database software

Preferred Qualifications

An understanding of higher education and/or non-profit
businesses
Event management experience

BU Benefits and Perks

Please check out Butler’s
Total Rewards website to learn more about our benefit

8 Paid Holidays

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans including

Eligibility after 9 months of full-time employment

Butler Facilities Access, Discounts and Perks :

Access to Butler’s on-site fitness facility and libraries for
full-time staff and faculty
LinkedIn Learning Courses
Free premium subscription to the Calm App
Free subscription to the WSJ, The Economist, and NYT
Discount at the College Bookstore
Discount on select Athletic and Arts/Events Center
Performances



About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
